session_watch.ready_detail: Monitoring is connected. Screen and sleep protection need separate checks.
session_watch.screen_unavailable: Screen locking is unavailable. Sleep locking works. Lock Tokenlogue manually before leaving.
session_watch.system_unavailable: Screen locking works. Sleep locking is unavailable. Lock Tokenlogue manually before sleep or leaving.
session_watch.unavailable: Automatic locking is unavailable. Lock Tokenlogue manually before leaving.
local_protection.problem_notice: Automatic locking did not work. Check your system settings and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.unconfirmed_notice: The result could not be confirmed. Try the check again and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.untested_notice: Automatic screen locking has not been checked. Use Test screen lock in the menu.
local_protection.unavailable_notice: Start the check to prepare screen monitoring. Until it is confirmed, lock Tokenlogue manually before leaving.
local_protection.test_explanation: This locks your operating-system screen. After you unlock it, Tokenlogue should ask for your app PIN.
local_protection.request_unavailable: The system screen lock could not be requested in this session. Lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.screen_monitor_unavaila: Screen monitoring is not ready yet.
local_protection.preparation_timeout: Screen lock preparation took too long. Try again. Lock Tokenlogue manually until the check succeeds.
local_protection.preparation_unavailable: The system screen lock could not be prepared safely. Try again or continue with manual app locking.
local_protection.locker_unconfirmed: Password-protected screen locking could not be confirmed in this session. Try again and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.already_locked: Make sure the operating-system screen is unlocked, then try the check again.
local_protection.observation_unavailable: The screen lock observation was interrupted. Try again and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.lock_timeout: The screen lock was not confirmed in time. Try the check again.
local_protection.unlock_timeout: The check ended while waiting for the operating-system screen to be unlocked. Unlock normally and run the check again.
local_protection.pin_unconfirmed: The app PIN screen could not be confirmed after screen locking. Try again and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.normal_unconfirmed: The check could not confirm the app’s automatic locking. Try again and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.observer_changed_notice: Run the screen lock check for the current system connection.
local_protection.unsupported_notice: This system does not support the screen lock check. Lock Tokenlogue manually before leaving.
local_protection.sleep_test_explanation: This puts your computer to sleep. Wake it and unlock the operating-system screen normally. Tokenlogue should then ask for your app PIN.
local_protection.both_confirmed: Screen lock and sleep protection confirmed
local_protection.contract_changed: The protection mechanism has changed. The previous check is retained. Check this mechanism again.
local_protection.save_failed: This result could not be saved on this device. A successful check in this session does not confirm saved history.
local_protection.save_failed_short: Protection result could not be saved
local_protection.monitor_not_ready_short: Past check retained. Current monitoring is not ready
local_protection.screen_monitor_warning: Screen monitoring is not ready. The previous check is retained, but current protection is not confirmed. Lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.sleep_monitor_warning: Sleep monitoring is not ready. The previous check is retained, but current protection is not confirmed. Lock Tokenlogue manually before sleep.
local_protection.attempt_unconfirmed: The latest attempt was not confirmed. It does not replace the completed check.
local_protection.sleep_request_unavailab: The operating system could not put this computer to sleep. Try again or use manual app locking.
local_protection.sleep_not_supported: Sleep is unavailable on this device. Lock Tokenlogue manually before leaving.
local_protection.sleep_permission_denied: The operating system did not permit sleep. Check your system settings and try again.
local_protection.sleep_inhibited: Another application is preventing sleep. Try again when it has finished.
local_protection.sleep_unproven: A real sleep and wake cycle was not confirmed. The previous completed check is retained.
local_protection.sleep_pin_unconfirmed: The app PIN screen could not be confirmed after waking. Try again and lock Tokenlogue manually for now.
local_protection.sleep_timeout: The sleep check did not finish in time. The previous completed check is retained.
local_protection.sleep_preparation_timeo: Sleep preparation took too long. Try again.
local_protection.sleep_observer_changed: Sleep monitoring changed during this attempt. Try again. The previous completed check is retained.
local_protection.check_required_short: Protection mechanism needs a new check
local_protection.screen_observed: Checked during normal operating-system screen locking.
local_protection.check_time_unavailable: The last check time is unavailable.
local_protection.success_time_unavailabl: The last successful check time is unavailable.
